About

The Actor

Rohit Waikos is a Mumbai-based actor known for his strong screen presence and ability to adapt into diverse roles — from intense dramatic characters to charming modern personalities.

With a natural flair for emotional depth and physical transformation, Rohit brings authenticity to every frame he inhabits, creating characters that linger long after the scene ends.

His training and instinct for craft have made him a reliable presence across major television productions, earning him roles that demand both range and precision.
